parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the edge instance. On the **Edge Instances** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover your mouse pointer over the name of the target edge instance to obtain the instance ID.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the IoT Platform instance:
- Enterprise instance: This parameter is required. You can view the instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the [IoT Platform console](http://iot.console.aliyun.com/).
- Public instance: This parameter is not required.

parameters.name: RouteId
parameters.description: The ID of the message route. You can call the [QueryEdgeInstanceMessageRouting](~~212633~~) operation to obtain the ID.
